primary_sources: ggml-org/llama.cpp current libmtmd API and issue tracker

main_question: Can the existing Qwen vision/mmproj encode be reused as the adaptive MVC/deep visual representation without a second heavy visual backbone while preserving calibrated open-set behavior and runtime correctness?
main_result: Physical feature reuse is directly implementable. However raw merged mmproj features are not yet proven calibrated for instance/layout familiarity. The next cheapest discriminator is merged-feature MVC first, with a tiny learned projection only if required; a separate heavy visual encoder remains a counterbaseline, not the default architecture.
reason_not_promoted: No matched target-runtime open-set benchmark has been executed yet.
